B0921T7L2V.title: Zooz 800 Series Z-Wave Long Range S2 Dimmer Switch ZEN77 800LR, White | Simple Direct 3-Way and 4-Way Solution (Works with Regular Switches, No Aux Switch Needed) | Z-Wave Hub Required
bullets: WIRELESS BRIGHTNESS CONTROL: Turn your lights on or off and dim them with Z-Wave. Works with all of the LED's other dimmers flicker with (120 VAC only, no 0-10V control)! Hub required (sold separately), scroll down for compatibility. Voice control with Z-Wave hub ONLY (will NOT work directly with your smart speaker).

NEW 800 SERIES Z-WAVE LONG RANGE: Boost your network with the latest Z-Wave technology that offers more range and faster signal speed than ever before. Your hub (or home automation software) needs to support Z-Wave Long Range for extra reliable direct-to-hub communication. Each dimmer will act as a signal extender in a traditional mesh network. And if you need to troubleshoot connectivity issues, access a built-in range test tool straight from the switch!

SIMPLE 3-WAY & 4-WAY: Use it with existing on/off switches (NO dimmers) in your 3-way, 4-way, or 5-way set-up, even if load and line are not in the same box. No need for add-on switches, no need to rewire other boxes. Just wire the Zooz in the box with direct connection to power and neutral (check your boxes before buying).

FASTER INSTALLATION: The new model is just 1.16" deep so it will fit a shallow or crowded box much easier! It takes half the time to install the S2 switches in 3-way and 4-way set-ups than for any other Z-Wave solution. Intuitive wiring diagrams are printed in the manual (look for more on the Zooz website) and if you need custom instructions, just ask!

MORE FEATURES: Double tap to go from off to full brightness (single tap to last brightness level - now fully programmable if your hub supports advanced settings). Multi-color LED indicator with adjustable brightness level, night light mode, and many more features to customize the dimmer (if you have access to advanced features from your hub).
